title: Which Programme Lasted?
summary: Boss: a three-group study, start to finish: change scores, describe, assumptions, one-way ANOVA with η², Tukey post hoc tests, a plot and the APA write-up.

steps.title: Import
steps.summary: Read pd_study.csv into `pd` with `programme` as a factor (Workshop, Coaching, Online) and the change score `gain`.

steps.title: Describe
steps.summary: `group_stats`: n, M and SD of gain per programme.

steps.title: Assumptions
steps.summary: Levene's test (SPSS-style) in `levene`; fit the ANOVA in `fit` and test its residuals in `residual_check`.

steps.title: ANOVA
steps.summary: The ANOVA table in `anova_table` and η² in `eta2`.

steps.title: Plot
steps.summary: `fig`: gain by programme, with readable axis labels.

steps.title: Write it up
steps.summary: Your `decision` at α = .05 and the APA sentence in `write_up`.

hints: Import: `read_csv("pd_study.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |> mutate(programme = factor(programme, levels = c("Workshop", "Coaching", "Online")), gain = efficacy_t3 - efficacy_t1)`.
Assumptions: `leveneTest(gain ~ programme, data = pd, center = mean)`, `fit <- aov(gain ~ programme, data = pd)` and `shapiro.test(residuals(fit))`.
Write-up: the F row is `anova_table[1, ]`: `sprintf("*F*(%d, %d) = %s, *p* %s, η² = %s", a$Df[1], a$Df[2], fmt_num(a$"F value"[1]), fmt_p(a$"Pr(>F)"[1]), fmt_bounded(eta2$Eta2))`.
